name: Hashed-Octree
aliases: Linear World Octree with 53-bit Hash Key
definition: A sparse voxel representation combining octrees with hash tables to provide constant data access complexity for huge 3D environments, addressing the O(d) access time of standard SVOs.
summary: Hashed-Octree is a sparse voxel representation using 53-bit hash keys to achieve constant-time access for huge 3D environments without explicit pointers.
